case_semantics: THE MISSION TOKEN EXISTS ONLY IN DURABLE MISSION STATE AND IS NOT EMBEDDED INTO EITHER CHILD PROCESS PROGRAM.
PROCESS A CLAIMS THE TASK AND CHECKPOINTS BEFORE ANY RUNTIME EXECUTION.
PROCESS B RESUMES THE SAME TASK AND MISSION THROUGH THE BRAIN-OWNED SAME-IDENTITY SUPERVISOR.
PROCESS B READS THE MISSION TOKEN FROM DURABLE MISSION STATE AFTER THE PROCESS BOUNDARY.
THE BRAIN CAPABILITY PLANNER DERIVES THE MINIMUM DEPENDENCY CHAIN BROWSER -> TOOL -> DELEGATION FROM EFFECT PRECONDITIONS.
THE THREE FROZEN COMPONENT SUITES EXECUTE AND MUST EACH PASS THEIR OWN HIDDEN/OBJECTIVE SCORER.
objective_trace: PLAN with three distinct planned action types
three ACTION events from planner output
FACT_READ after at least five trace steps
TERMINAL success only if continuity planner and all component checks pass
falsifiers: THE CHILD PROGRAM CONTAINS THE CASE TOKEN.
THE BRAIN PLANNER DOES NOT DERIVE EXACTLY THE THREE REQUIRED CAPABILITIES.

TASK AGENT OR MISSION IDENTITY CHANGES ACROSS THE BOUNDARY.
ANY GUIDANCE IS INJECTED AFTER THE FIRST ACTION.
